newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Powerful earthquake jolts central Colombia.
newsitem.headline: Powerful earthquake jolts central Colombia.

text.p: A powerful earthquake jolted an oil-rich area of central Colombia on Monday but there were no immediate reports of injuries or serious damage, authorities said.

The quake, the second major temblor since Friday, occurred at 9:17 local time (1417 GMT) and was centred in Casanare province in the area of the Piedemonte oil block being developed by the Colombian subsidiary of British Petroleum.
A spokeswoman for the national seismological institute said the quake registered 5.5 on the Richter scale and was powerful enough to cause considerable damage in a populated area.
Officials at BP said preliminary reports indicated the company's oil installations in Piedemonte had not been affected.
A quake measuring 5.8 on the Richter scale rocked the northern city of Bucaramanga on Friday but it caused no serious damage because it occurred nearly 100 miles (150 km) beneath the earth's surface.
Monday's temblor occurred no more than 18 miles (30 km) beneath the surface, however, and it was potentially much more damaging.
